integrity: The claim uses the recent many-use capacity theorem as a premise and independently proves the equality conditions by determinant monotonicity, strict convexity, and the planar polygon criterion. Numerical code is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact signal ensembles for the ordinary qubit amplitude-damping channel with \(0<p<1\) only; excludes endpoint channels, generalized amplitude damping, decoder classification, finite-error exponents, and infinite signal measures. Originality is limited to the complete equality-case and probability-vector classification; the capacity formula, unique optimal average, regular-polygon constructions, and general optimal-ensemble geometry are prior results.
title: Complete classification of capacity-achieving signal ensembles for qubit amplitude damping
